title: Symplectic Weil Representation on Orthogonal Direct Sums
body_html:
Symplectic Weil Representation on Orthogonal Direct Sums

Let

$$ E=\bigoplus_r E^r $$

be an orthogonal direct sum of nondegenerate symplectic spaces, and let $S^r=S(E^r,j_r)$. Then, after restricting from $S(E,j)$ to $\prod_r S^r$, the symplectic Weil representation factors as the tensor product

$$ W_\xi^{E,j}\big|_{\prod_r S^r} = \bigotimes_r W_\xi^{E^r,j_r}. $$
